scope: FSH day-3 source only; published literal P50 column. No E2 implementation.

source.authors: Grisendi V, Spada E, Argento C, Plebani M, Milani S, Seracchioli R, Volpe A, La Marca A
source.title: Age-specific reference values for serum FSH and estradiol levels throughout the reproductive period
source.publicationVersion: Published typeset journal article, not a preprint; user-supplied PDF includes publisher cover plus all five article pages.
source.verification: Full article and Table 1 inspected; methods page 452 and printed table page 454 checked visually at full page and enlarged PDF render. CSV is auxiliary table rendering, not participant-level data or independent validation.

originalFileManifest.originalFilename: Age-specific reference values for serum FSH and estradiol levels throughout the reproductive period.pdf

originalFileManifest.origin: User-supplied attachment; matches printed table and PDF text

medianDefinition.quote: The M and S curves correspond to the median and coefficient of variation of FSH and E2

column.heading: 50th (M)
column.kind: Literal published model-estimated age-specific median; not empirical separate-year group medians, a mean or a reconstructed centile.

sourceAgeGlyph.decision: Explicit letter/digit interpretation for the ordered age row, visually verified; all P50 concentration cells are preserved exactly.

csvVsPdfText.limitation: Machine text comparison supplemented by visual inspection; not accepted from OCR alone.

canonicalP50Pairs.encoding: UTF-8 compact JSON of numeric [ageYears,P50] pairs in ascending age, no final newline

cohort.studyDesign: Cross-sectional single-centre clinic sample, Modena, Italy
exclusions: Sex hormone administration in previous 6 months
History of pelvic inflammatory disease or ovarian surgery
Known chronic, systemic, metabolic or endocrine disease including hyperandrogenism
notReported: Numbers of women near each age or endpoint
Exact observed minimum and maximum age distinct from recruitment criteria
Confirmed ovulation and fertility outcomes for every participant
Formal low-result censoring or imputation protocol
cohort.transportLimit: Not a random population sample or an independently validated fertility/ovarian-reserve test.

ageStatements.applicationPlacement: Whole possible entered age interval must be >18 and <=44; >18 is application policy, not an author-defined cohort boundary.
ageStatements.noExtrapolation: No age45 row, post44 plateau or extension from rounded slope.

assay.sampling: Menstrual cycle day3 for all blood samples
assay.preparation: 2000g for10min; serum stored in polypropylene tubes at -80C
assay.method: Chemiluminescent FSH assay, ADVIA Centaur, Siemens Healthcare Diagnostics, Italy
assay.sensitivityMeaning: Reported sensitivity; source does not formally define or verify this as LOD or LOQ.
notReported: Number and handling of low or out-of-range results
assay.censoring: Unknown; no inference that low values did not occur, and no replacement of patient inequalities by a concentration.

statisticalAudit.method: CG-LMS, LMS Program1.29; M is median. Source L=0.186472. Literal M alone is the accepted extraction.

MLinearRoundingFeasibility.interpretation: A line can intersect all printed rounding intervals; its fitted coefficients are not imported or attributed to authors.

medianFromQuartiles.interpretation: Internal algebraic cross-check independent of printed S; same source table, not external population validation.

fullLMS.roundingMethod: Half-unit intervals: M/y +/-0.0005, S +/-0.00005, L +/-0.0000005; exact8-corner envelope plus cell rounding.
fullLMS.conclusion: Printed S is systematically inconsistent with the centiles; not a ready full LMS model. No inferred S or correction is imported.

excludedProducts: P5–P95 as laboratory RI or CI
Global fitted coefficients attributed to authors

acceptedApplicationScope.ownerDecision: Mockup and implementation accepted after full-text/numerical review and disclosure of LMS errors. This is authorization for the limited product scope, not independent clinical validation.
acceptedApplicationScope.dayContext: One optional local question for this current FSH result: unknown/day3/other. Source information and median remain available without day3; patient point requires day3 and all comparison gates.

interpolation.kind: Linear interpolation between adjacent literal published M values only
interpolation.scope: Fractional age within source knots; explicit application policy, not author coefficients or reconstructed LMS
interpolation.sourceLine: Linear polyline through literal age/M pairs

acceptedApplicationScope.knownContraindications: Known incompatible reproductive/therapy context and explicit assay/specimen mismatch remain gates. No new history/assay/specimen questionnaire; unknown is not negative.
acceptedApplicationScope.inequalities: No exact patient point, percentile or concentration imputation for inequality/LOD/LOQ results; source median is not a patient measurement.
acceptedApplicationScope.historyPolicy: This educational read-only block adds no persisted day3 answer, hormoneReference snapshot, pinned assessment or history schema. Existing historical results are not re-evaluated.
acceptedApplicationScope.statePolicy: Day3 choice belongs to the current result; change of patient, analyte, age, phase/source context or measurement clears it; ordinary refresh of same result can preserve it; clear/reset wipes state.

phasePolicy.day3WithUnknownOrAbsentOrFollicular: May satisfy collection-timing gate; all other comparison gates still required
phasePolicy.knownOvulationOrLuteal: Source information stays ready; no patient point due to incompatible cycle phase
phasePolicy.pregnancyOrPostmenopause: Whole Grisendi block unavailable; existing laboratory and Roche contracts remain separate
phasePolicy.noInference: Do not infer cycle day from age, concentration or phase; do not rewrite phase to match day3

unchangedLayers: Stricker cycle geometry and source knots
validationMeaning: Source integrity and internal statistical checks completed. Production evaluator/UI/PWA tests and current-SHA GitHub checks are reported by the integrating PR; no assertion here of completed runtime checks or independent clinical validation.

completedSourceChecks.runtimeLiteralP50: All29 [ageYears,median] runtime knots exactly match quoted Table1 M pairs

completedSourceChecks.runtimeTestClaim: No production-test or CI pass is asserted by this source audit; integrating agent reports actual validation.
